title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Settlement Schedule — Amount of the Dispute Settlement Credit
content:
**Clause.** The dispute settlement credit on a Ridgeline Pro Credit account is the disputed amount recorded on the approved invoice dispute request, credited in full against the disputed invoice and rounded to the nearest cent.

## Records the amount is taken from

| Quantity | Record |
|---|---|
| The approved invoice dispute request | The invoice dispute request on the account in approved status; where several stand approved, the one most recently filed |
| Disputed amount | The disputed amount recorded on that request |
| Disputed invoice | The invoice line the request names |

## Worked example (hypothetical)

An invoice of 3180.00 on a Commercial Account Net 30 is disputed for 427.50, and the request is approved. The dispute settlement credit is 427.50, credited against that invoice; rounded to the nearest cent it remains 427.50.

| Input | Value |
|---|---|
| Invoice total | 3180.00 |
| Disputed amount on the approved request | 427.50 |
| Dispute settlement credit | 427.50 |

## Basis Q&A

**Which request is read when the business has more than one approved invoice dispute?** The approved request most recently filed.
